howTheCohortWasChosen: All 87 SOURCE_READY families in MASTER_QUEUE were intersected against the live packet-build claims. Seven held no live claim: their grants had been released unbuilt by PF01, PF02, PF03, PF05, PF06 and PF18, and all seven were still artifactStatus NOT_RENDERED and completenessStatus NOT_BUILT. Every other SOURCE_READY family is live on another lane, so those seven were the whole available set and the cohort is all of them. No two share a writable path: each owns one exclusive overlay directory and one exclusive build script, and none names a shared build host.

theBlocker.what: Form 4-960.1 NMRA, the statewide notice of hearing bound as component 2, carries four repeated service blocks — Name, Agency (if applicable), Address, Telephone Number and Email Address, twenty measured blanks in all — for the people served with the notice.
theBlocker.whyItCannotBeClassified: On THIS track no one is served. The held record states it twice: rules.notice records that no responding party is entitled to notice under Rule 1-077.1(E) NMRA, and rules.service records "none. Service of the petition and attachments is required only for the release-without-conviction and conviction tracks." The correct disposition is therefore NOT_APPLICABLE_ON_THIS_ROUTE with a named route condition, which is exactly what BLANK_DISPOSITIONS describes. But that disposition is not reachable by declaration: classifyBlank validates a declared disposition against the vocabulary and then falls through to class inference and the APPROVED_REASONS prose table, whose only routes to NOT_APPLICABLE_ON_THIS_ROUTE are the attorney-only, viewer-control and never-a-filing-fact patterns. None of them describes a service block on a track that requires no service.
theBlocker.whatThisLaneWouldHaveHadToDoInstead: either edit scripts/rcap-packet-completeness/completeness-contract.mjs, which is shared machinery every family's counters are read through and not a packet-build lane's to change mid-cohort, or dress the refusal in prose that matches an existing pattern in order to clear a counter. The second is the thing the counters exist to prevent, and a family whose nine counters are zeroed by a matched regex rather than by a correct classification is a worse artifact than an unbuilt one.
theBlocker.whoResolvesIt: the owner of the completeness contract, by making NOT_APPLICABLE_ON_THIS_ROUTE reachable from an explicit declaration that names its route condition, on the same discipline REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING already uses

twoLegalFindingsThatOutliveThisStop.finding: The bound local order form asks, on its page 4, for "Name of actual offender:" and "Contact information:" — measured at p4 y405.48 and y391.68, plus two continuation lines.
twoLegalFindingsThatOutliveThisStop.whyItMatters: The same track's own record forbids exactly that. selfHelpStopConditions names "Any suggestion, from the participant or anyone else, that LegalEase name the true offender anywhere in the packet or the proposed order" as a stop condition, and the legal-design decision carries a self_help_boundary limitation headed "Never name an alleged identity thief in a proposed order", explaining that Rule 1-077.1 deliberately omits the Section 29-3A-3(D) requirement that the court insert the true offender's name because naming an alleged identity thief in a civil proceeding without notice to that person would violate due process.
twoLegalFindingsThatOutliveThisStop.consequence: whoever builds this family must refuse those blanks explicitly and tell the participant why, and must not treat them as ordinary required-before-filing facts. They are the clearest third-party blanks in the cohort.

twoLegalFindingsThatOutliveThisStop.finding: The local order is the retained order form of ONE judicial district, filed in the Master Library under 05_SOURCE_GATED. Its manifest entry records its official_title as "Petitioner." — the harvest could not read a title off it — and notes that no statewide Supreme Court order form exists in the mandatory 4-951 to 4-960.3 set.
twoLegalFindingsThatOutliveThisStop.whyItMatters: the packet-set manifest already marks the component conditional on the participant filing in that district, and the record requires a local_order_form_instructions component telling everyone else to obtain their own district's form. A build that shipped the retained order unconditionally would assert one district's practice as statewide.
twoLegalFindingsThatOutliveThisStop.notAStopOnItsOwn: source-gated is a release gate rather than a build gate in this factory — many built families bind 05_SOURCE_GATED assets — so this is a finding for counsel and the raster gate, not a refusal.

workThatIsFinishedAndTransferable.what: every blank on all four bound documents, measured first hand from the pinned binaries and bound to their digests: 71 on Form 4-951, 36 on Form 4-960.1, 41 on the local order and all 158 AcroForm fields of Form 4-222, with annotation flags, source-authored values and the printed context of each blank
alsoEstablished: these New Mexico rule forms are FLAT: three of the four carry no AcroForm at all, so this family needs the measured-overlay builder pattern (finalizeFlatOverlay plus measured write boxes) rather than the AcroForm pattern the Texas family in this cohort uses

their blanks are underscore GLYPH runs far more often than stroked rules, which the existing measureRuledBlank does not find. A run-based measurer reading the per-glyph x and advance from the shared anchor-capture walker was written and proved against the pinned bytes; the census file records the geometry it produced.

New Mexico rule forms mark amended text by underlining and bracketing it, so a builder that read every horizontal stroke as a blank would invent write boxes under the amendment marks. Ten such strokes on Form 4-951 alone are recorded separately as underlinesOfPrintedText.
finalizeFlatOverlay was smoke-tested against the pinned Form 4-951 bytes and writes and fits correctly, so nothing about the drawing path blocks this family
no widget on Form 4-222 is Hidden or NoView, and no document in the family ships a source-authored value

captainDisposition.finding: UPHELD AND CLOSED. classifyBlank accepted NOT_APPLICABLE_ON_THIS_ROUTE as in vocabulary and then never honoured a declaration of it: the only paths that reached the disposition were the attorney-only and viewer-control prose patterns and the NOT_A_FILING_FACT class. A Maryland builder had written the same finding into a comment at scripts/build-census-v1-md_second_chance_shielding-set.mjs:1501.
captainDisposition.change: A declared channel now exists. A row may state disposition NOT_APPLICABLE_ON_THIS_ROUTE together with routeConditionThatMakesItInapplicable naming the branch, rule or route fact that puts the blank outside the route. The declaration is refused when the named condition is policy-shaped prose, when the row also declares routeDetermined, or when the packet writes the same fact elsewhere. A row that names no condition falls through to every path that existed before, so the gate adds a channel and removes none.
captainDisposition.measured: All 29 rows in the repository that declare this disposition were read through both contract versions. Zero read differently. ca-1203-4-set and hi_dag_danc_expungement-set were verified before and after and both still return PASS_COMPLETE.
